posts.author: catboy_izzie
posts.body:
Hello everyone, I'm Izzie! I've been working on stuff with RPG Maker XP for a few months now, and finally made an account on here to be able to get advice when needed and hopefully be able to maintain motivation for working on stuff (something I am very bad at lol)
I am an artist and I have a passion for writing and creating silly little characters and making an rpg is a great way to combine those passions. Also obviously I love video games lol
Anyways, I look forward to chatting with y'all on here!
